metadata.defaultTitle: EVERA WORKS: Expert teams that power your operations
metadata.description: EVERA connects global companies with dedicated, expert teams that take ownership of the operations you need to scale, from sales and customer support to specialized back-office.

hero.badge: Dedicated teams · Global coverage · On your schedule
hero.subtitle: EVERA connects you with dedicated professionals who take ownership of the work that moves your business forward — integrated into your tools, your hours and your standards.

showcase.title: A team that operates like your own
showcase.subtitle: Your dedicated EVERA team plugs into your workflow with clear reporting and real accountability — you stay in control, without the overhead of building it yourself.

stats.title: Built for how you actually work

services.title: Connect a team for whatever your business needs
services.subtitle: Specialized professionals who take ownership of a function and run it as a seamless extension of your company.

whyEvera.title: Why companies partner with EVERA
whyEvera.subtitle: Everything you expect from an in-house team, delivered as a true extension of yours.

ownership.title: True ownership
ownership.description: Your team takes responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks — proactive, accountable and invested in your success.

flexible.title: Coverage on your schedule
flexible.description: Daytime, overnight or around the clock — your team works the hours your business needs, in whatever timezone you serve.

bilingual.title: Seamless communication
bilingual.description: Bilingual, culturally aligned professionals your customers and your team connect with effortlessly.

integration.title: Plugs into your stack
integration.description: We work inside your tools and processes, so it feels like hiring in-house — without the overhead.

scalable.title: Scales with you
scalable.description: Add capacity or stand up new functions as you grow, without slow, costly hiring cycles.

quality.title: Expert, vetted talent
quality.description: Rigorously selected and trained professionals — quality you can rely on from day one.

industries.title: Sectors we serve
industries.subtitle: Deep experience across the industries that depend on responsive, dependable teams.

contactCta.title: Let's build your team
contactCta.subtitle: Tell us what your business needs and we'll design a dedicated team around it.
